assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Asset type: a production nine-slice ornamental desktop sidebar panel, not a screenshot or a mockup. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact very tall narrow 1:3 canvas proportions, outer rounded rectangular silhouette, transparent exterior, the top-left bow location and footprint, top-right small star details, all thin side rails, bottom ribbon/frill strip, and broad completely empty central space. Redraw ONLY the color/material treatment as an elegant, comfortable LIGHT THEME to coordinate with warm ivory app content and a pale neutral gray sidebar. Replace the almost black burgundy central fill with very pale warm ivory #f7f7f2, a nearly imperceptible fine paper texture, no strong gradients or shadows. Replace bright antique-gold rails with slim soft champagne-silver, low contrast and delicate. Redraw the bow as soft muted dusty-rose fabric with pale cream piping, a small desaturated sage/sea-glass jewel, and gentle taupe metalwork; it must remain small, quiet and confined to the same top-left corner. Bottom ribbon should be pale dusty rose and ivory, restrained not saturated. Maintain crisp geometry: straight thin side borders with no ornaments in their middle stretch so the frame can be nine-sliced vertically without artifacts; all decorative shapes remain entirely in the original top 10.6%, bottom 6.7%, and side 12.4% bands. Interior is fully opaque ivory, exterior genuinely transparent alpha. Keep the central fill entirely blank with no text, icons, characters, controls or logos. Preserve existing transparency outside the rounded panel. Avoid black, maroon, saturated red, yellow-gold glare, heavy leather texture, new flourishes or added objects. The result is the standalone flat asset, front-on, no perspective, no surrounding UI.
